children: Indonesian coal miner PT Bayan Resources
said on Thursday that it has lifted force majeure on coal supplies after the company and its units were allowed to revise their 2026 mining quotas.
Bayan said it expects the three affected mining units to resume operations soon, according to a stock exchange filing.
